data.name: Lumina: Resenting Shadow
data.detailed_description:
Delve into the Kingdom of Lumina

The once Gleaming and renowned Kingdom has become a dim sight from what it once was. A vast place for creatures of all manners and sizes, living under the protection of the Shining King. The home of a young moth named Luma, who unknowingly is about to lose everything they've ever known. But can they bring back that spark that once made this kingdom so mighty in the first place.

Locations

The Kingdom of Lumina has many different locations to explore. Walk through the glorious Gleaming City, or Dive into the sewers in The Underbelly. Take a stroll through the beautiful gardens of the royal family, or fight through overgrown and forgotten lands. Each location bringing new enemies, bosses, and challenges to overcome!

Gameplay

Explore the Kingdom of Lumina, overturn every stone to find precious trinkets, friends, and foes alike. Use the small bit of light still within you to help guide your journey, and unlock new ways to harness it through powerful bursts of energy, or simply pulling yourself through the air by making a physical lasso of light. You never know what you might be able to create.

Along the way you may also find Bulbs, which allow you to differ your playthrough with different abilities. Some may simply grant more money from enemies, while others allow you to defy death and dodge incoming damage entirely. How you mix and match these are up to you, and some may even allow you to interact with the world in entirely different ways.

Features

  • 5 Main Story explorable regions, with a few extra ones for those who venture.

  • Story and optional/secret bosses spread throughout the world for you to find and challenge!

  • Many different creatures you can meet and call friend. You never know what kind of story they can tell.

  • Tons of foes across all of the regions! From tiny bugs, to giant living rocks, to the pitched creatures of the void.

  • Many secrets spread across the world for you to find. Hidden in small cracks, and puzzles for you to solve.

  • A Bulb System that allows you to change how you play and interact with the world. Will you opt for more survivability? or will you drop your enemies faster than they can land a strike!

data.short_description: Journey through a kingdom drained of its life. An innocent being locked away from its own kind, longing to be loved and seen. Though it seems to have forgotten one flicker of hope. You, a glimmer of life not yet fallen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or above
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core Processor @ 2GHz
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
